source_detail: Built in ca-tools 2026-11-10 by exhaustive search with no input array and no random numbers. Rows are permuted by two cycles of length 6, two cycles of length 3 and two fixed rows. The program programs/orbfree3.c lists every binary column whose 6 images under that row permutation form a strength 3 array by themselves (19,140 column orbits), joins orbits whose union has strength 3, and lists every set of 4 such orbits that contains a representative under the normaliser of the row permutation (8 sets, each a 20 x 24 covering array). No set of 5 orbits exists. For each set it lists every further column that keeps strength 3 with the 24 columns and finds the largest set of such columns that keeps strength 3 together. The array is the first set that reaches 28 columns (command orbfree3 20 4 a 6 6 3 3 1 1, under one second). Exact check with ca_verify on all triples of columns and with a separate brute force check
construction: Array invariant under a row permutation with cycles 6, 6, 3, 3, 1, 1 on its first 24 columns: four column orbits of length 6 and four further columns, found by exhaustive search
notes: beats the cited size 23 at k = 28 by 3 rows; no Torres-Jimenez array is an ingredient or start; no input array; the search program was written by an AI model for this project
